text: **Hint 1:** Consider how LASSO regularization affects the complexity of the model. LASSO tends to shrink some coefficients to zero, effectively reducing the number of features used in the model. How might this impact the model's performance on unseen data?\n\n**Hint 2:** Think about the bias-variance tradeoff. LASSO regularization can increase bias by simplifying the model, but it can also decrease variance by preventing overfitting. How do these changes in bias and variance affect the MSE on held-out test data?
